name: SQL (PostgreSQL)
description: Syntax checks and formatting for PostgreSQL SQL files.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can check PostgreSQL syntax and format SQL files without a database connection. The language server starts when a SQL file opens in a project and stops when none are open. For schema-aware completion, hover information and database checks, configure a PostgreSQL connection in the project’s postgres-language-server.jsonc file. This server supports the PostgreSQL dialect.
ready: Ready to assist with PostgreSQL SQL.
failed: The PostgreSQL SQL language server could not start.
